audit_status: POSTHOC: triggered after model-error inspection identified im_19_arch MT disagreement
method: Within each image/metric/rater set: linear-interpolated quartiles, Tukey1.5*IQR fences. No values excluded or replaced.
limitations: Disagreement does not establish which rater or entry is correct; no correction is inferred.
Small rater count and very small IQR can flag clinically small differences.
All-available and complete-six scans overlap; their flags must not be added as independent observations.
The median-rater reference is a uniform posthoc sensitivity analysis across every image and metric, not a replacement primary target or an independent validation.
Do not attribute a large residual to model boundaries until reference disagreement is considered.
